title.zh: Stripe联创：收购Privy后其收入增至此前约9倍，钱包资产规模增至约25倍
title.en: Stripe联创：收购Privy后其收入增至此前约9倍，钱包资产规模增至约25倍

current_state.zh: Stripe co-founder Patrick Collison said Privy's wallet assets have grown ~25x, monthly active developers ~3x, and revenue ~9x since acquisition, with Stripe now deeply integrating Privy into Treasury, Link and Connect and building a unified API for stablecoin balances, yield, fiat on/off-ramps, card spending and AI-agent transactions processing nearly $25B monthly.
